evidence: Carries the Mempool label and fixes incorrect eviction of valid unconfirmed transactions and their descendants from the mempool during reorganizations.
rationale: Fixes a noticeable bug where reorgs lowering chain tip or median time past falsely evict valid BIP68 transactions and their descendants. As described in issue #35007, transactions with unconfirmed parents held stale cached lockpoints that passed validity tests, leading `removeForReorg` to reject valid transactions instead of recalculating lockpoints at the new tip.
